name: Missy
oracle_text:
Whenever another nonartifact creature dies, return it to the battlefield under your control face down and tapped. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent faces a villainous choice — Each artifact creature you control deals 1 damage to that opponent, or you draw a card and chaos ensues.
blocked_sentences: Whenever another nonartifact creature dies, return it to the battlefield under your control face down and tapped. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent faces a villainous choice — Each artifact creature you control deals 1 damage to that opponent, or you draw a card and chaos ensues

needs.what: a face-down characteristics override (708.2a) on the effect that puts a card onto the battlefield face down: return_from_graveyard with face_down true plus printed types/subtypes for the shell, so the returned card is a nameless colorless 2/2 face-down permanent that is an artifact creature with subtype Cyberman (the same override Cyber Conversion needs for turn_face_down)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard already takes face_down, tapped and controller, but its face-down shell is the plain 708.2 2/2 creature with no types or subtypes beyond Creature; animate or add_subtype after the return would layer effects on top rather than define the face-down characteristics, and would leave nothing for the face_down selector / turn_face_up to read consistently

needs.what: an op that makes chaos ensue (Planechase 311.7/901.9): fires a chaos_ensues event that 'whenever chaos ensues' triggered abilities (on planes and on permanents such as Doctor Who cards) listen to
needs.why_existing_wont_do: there is no chaos op and no chaos_ensues trigger event in trigger_events; drawing a card alone would silently drop the clause, which matters as soon as any permanent with a 'whenever chaos ensues' trigger is on the battlefield. The villainous choice itself looks expressible as for_each_player over opponents with a choose_mode whose chooser is that player (the Damocles Base shape)
